Look up a new word where you find it. Keep it with its original context in Notes.

Point at a subtitle or on-screen word and press Control + Option + D (⌃⌥D). Click Pronounce to hear it; use Edit word if recognition needs correction.

First-launch setup guides permissions and notebook selection. Open Settings… later to recover permissions or change the save location. Screen Recording enables lookup; source capture and Apple Notes are optional. Choose an interface language on the first setup page.

Definitions use the selected local dictionary; pronunciation uses macOS voices. Open Dictionaries… to import an MDX file. Not every language has Chinese definitions; choose the text recognition language from the menu when needed.

Collections retain the word, original line, and available page title and URL. Another deliberate collection increases its count. Check Source… before saving. Vocabulary supports source filtering and JSON export; statistics cover only collections you made.

WordNest does not upload captures, entries or analytics and does not use cloud translation. On My Mac Notes storage stays local; Apple handles synchronization for iCloud accounts.

Fullscreen, protected video and some windows may prevent capture or source reading. Links can be entered manually. Notion is not connected. Press Esc to close.
